iterations.name: Paper
iterations.description: Warm, tactile, and a little slower.
iterations.rationale: Lead with a quiet botanical study. A generous image and a simple hierarchy make the session feel considered and approachable.

iterations.name: After hours
iterations.description: A bold invitation to switch off.
iterations.rationale: Try a darker, typographic direction. High contrast and an oversized headline give a quiet activity an unexpected presence.

iterations.name: Index
iterations.rationale: Borrow the structure of an index card. Rules, a numbered edition, and compact details give recurring sessions a recognizable format.

iterations.name: Soft focus
iterations.rationale: Let the illustration spill into a softer composition. Keep the action clear while making more space for warmth and personality.

iterations.name: Essential
iterations.rationale: Remove the illustration and bring the useful information forward. A compact alternative for a list of sessions or a smaller surface.
